e.title: pyIncore (IN-CORE 社区韧性)
e.summary: 社区韧性建模环境 IN-CORE 的 Python 接口（27★，2026 活跃）：基础设施互联+灾后恢复时序建模
e.body: pyincore（IN-CORE，27★，2026-09 活跃）是 IN-CORE（Interdependent Networked Community Resilience Modeling Environment）的 Python 客户端——面向社区韧性建模：评估灾害对相互依赖的基础设施系统的影响与灾后恢复过程（不止峰值损失，含恢复时序）。对 RIAA：超越单次损失估计的韧性（resilience）建模参考——基础设施互联失效与恢复曲线对保险/再保险的长期风险视角；与 [[lisflood]]（物理水文）、[[openquake-engine]]（地震）、[[thinkhazard]]（等级）互补成灾害-损失-恢复全链。
e.verified_note: raw GitHub 核实：IN-CORE pyincore 社区韧性建模客户端（27★ 活跃）
e.summary_en: Python client of IN-CORE community-resilience modelling (27★, active 2026): interdependent infrastructure + post-disaster recovery timing
e.summary_hk: 社區韌性建模環境 IN-CORE 的 Python 接口（27★，2026 活躍）：基礎設施互聯+災後恢復時序建模
e.body_en: pyincore (IN-CORE, 27★, active 2026-09) is the Python client of IN-CORE (Interdependent Networked Community Resilience Modeling Environment) for community resilience modelling: assessing hazard impacts on interdependent infrastructure systems and the post-disaster recovery process (not only peak loss but recovery timing). For RIAA: a resilience-modelling reference beyond single loss estimates — interdependent infrastructure failure and recovery curves give a long-term risk view for insurance/reinsurance; complements [[lisflood]] (physical hydrology), [[openquake-engine]] (earthquake) and [[thinkhazard]] (grades) into a hazard-loss-recovery chain.
e.body_hk: pyincore（IN-CORE，27★，2026-09 活躍）是 IN-CORE（Interdependent Networked Community Resilience Modeling Environment）的 Python 客戶端——面向社區韌性建模：評估災害對相互依賴的基礎設施系統的影響與災後恢復過程（不止峰值損失，含恢復時序）。對 RIAA：超越單次損失估計的韌性（resilience）建模參考——基礎設施互聯失效與恢復曲線對保險/再保險的長期風險視角；與 [[lisflood]]（物理水文）、[[openquake-engine]]（地震）、[[thinkhazard]]（等級）互補成災害-損失-恢復全鏈。
